title: Pan-Seared Cod with Salad
description: A simple yet flavorful Chinese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared cod served with a refreshing salad.

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens with your choice of vegetables

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Season the cod fillets with ground black pepper.
Add vegetable oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add your choice of vegetables from the salad and stir-fry until tender.
Return the cod to the skillet and serve with the salad.
Garnish with additional vegetables or herbs if desired.
